dedupe_keys.name: model for electricity markets and investments meli

description: Model for Electricity Markets and Investments (MELI) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Energiewirtschaftliches Institut an der Universität zu Köln (EWI). MELI is a linear optimization model that minimizes the costs of covering electricity demand by modeling the required investments in generation and storage capacities as well as their deployment, taking into account fixed and variable operating costs. Investment and deployment are optimized jointly. Coverage: Switzerland, Germany, United Kingdom, Norway, Ukraine. Methodical focus: Electricity Markets, Invest and Dispatch Decisions, Integration of RES. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: national states, regions. Software: GAMS. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
